workloads.why: one fold whose folded transcript does not fit the window bound; the typed memory marker is machine-preserved, so this prices the free-text loss alone
fat search observations reach the summarizer untrimmed, so the fold overflows the bound; the scored hit count sits in the MIDDLE search, the position a head-and-tail cut drops first
the committed repeatedly folding geometry, where the running summary re-enters the summarize input and the two trims can spend different byte totals

the published fold-step crossover cell fold-d10-step10-lo, at its own guard, share, depth and padding: a cap-fitting cell whose fold fits the window bound, so both trims must render byte-identical prompts

n_tasks is PER STRATUM for this builder (4 x head/middle/tail = 12 tasks); two per stratum could not absorb a single episode that leaves the folding regime, which is a power problem independent of the direction of the result. The stratum set the entry-aware recovery was first measured on, carried here so adoption re-measures the recovery under the promoted policy field instead of citing it

adoption_rule.no_regression: no workload may lose paired completion under per_entry_head against head_tail
adoption_rule.recovery: the middle stratum must recover under per_entry_head in every qualified family
adoption_rule.cost: total model-input chars and summary prompt chars must not rise
adoption_rule.default_change: recommend a default change only when the policy-change audit reports the shipped published cells invariant under the move
